title: treatment: Non-vernalized - rep1 [BB95]
extract_protocol_ch1: Pine tree extraction method (Chang et al 1993)
description: The 2nd leaf was harvested from non-vernalized plants that had been grown to the 3 leaf stage. All samples were harvested at the same time.
data_processing: The MAS5.0 Normalization is performed using the justMAS function in the simpleaffy package of Bioconductor (www.bioconductor.org). The target value is 500 for all cases. The code was developed using R2.4.1, Bioconductor 1.9, and simpleaffy 2.8.0. The CDF files were downloaded from the Bioconductor website at http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/AffymetrixChip.html. The normalization scripts are available from the PLEXdb team by request.
